networkExporters.stage.fetching.description: Export progress while retrieving stored interviews.

networkExporters.stage.formatting.description: Export progress while preparing session data for export.

networkExporters.stage.generating.description: Export progress while creating CSV or GraphML files.

networkExporters.stage.outputting.description: Export progress while writing the completed export files.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.c.description: Name of an interview’s case ID, the identifier the researcher gave the interview, shown in a list of the variables whose answers lost characters.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.d.defaultMessage: Some answers contained characters that GraphML cannot store, so they were removed from the GraphML files only. The CSV files keep every answer unchanged. The affected interviews and variables are:
networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.d.description: Explanation in the warning shown after an export, followed by a list of the interviews and the variables whose answers lost characters in the GraphML files. GraphML is a network file format. CSV is a spreadsheet file format.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.i.description: One entry in the list of interviews affected by removed characters. {caseId} is the interview’s case ID. {variables} is a list of the names of the variables, joined into a sentence, whose answers lost characters.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.t.defaultMessage: Some characters were removed from the GraphML files
networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.t.description: Heading of the warning shown after an export when some answers held characters that GraphML files cannot store.
